# Template profile bundle

This directory contains the default, vendor-neutral template-profile metadata for the TM7 generation extension.

## Included profile

- sdl_core_generic.yaml: the default generic profile using the verified generic stencil type IDs.

## License note

- LICENSE-MIT-REFERENCE.txt: states that the bundled profile metadata is independently authored, and that any redistributed upstream template files must retain their original copyright and permission notices.

## Reference-only profile tables

The Azure and PatrickGallucci profiles are intentionally not bundled as redistributed template files. They remain documented as reference-only mapping tables in `references/tm7-generation.md`.
